## Change over time[edit]


Between 1915 and 1940, American Kennel Club statistics were collected on a five-year basis instead of every year. Poodles would become the most popular breed for the longest, reigning from 1960 for the next twenty-two years until 1982, when the American Maltese once again took over until 1990.
